scripts.build: mkdir -p build && cp manifest.json build/ && cp src/styles.css build/ && esbuild src/background.js --bundle --minify --outfile=build/background.js && esbuild src/content.js --bundle --minify --outfile=build/content.js
scripts.watch: mkdir -p build && cp manifest.json build/ && cp src/styles.css build/ && esbuild src/background.js --bundle --minify --outfile=build/background.js --watch & esbuild src/content.js --bundle --minify --outfile=build/content.js --watch
